name: (anti)personal Convictions
source:
you are a plural system.

tonight is the 3 year anniversary celebration of you and your best friend starting hormones.

you are about to have a very bad night.

A visual novel about staying alive in spite of a world that wants you dead, and ruining your life because of it.

[Edited from [url=https://gnatjb.itch.io/antipersonal-convictions]itch.io[/url]]
